tasks.title: Задача 1
tasks.statement: Teams consisting of three or more students can participate in the group competition.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 2
tasks.statement: The team will be given a set of 5 problems to solve in 60 minutes.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 3
tasks.statement:
The team's result is decided by the sum total of the points obtained for all 5 problems. Up
   to 20 points can be obtained for each problem. The team can gain extra points by handing
   in their solutions to all 5 problems before the end of the allotted 60 minutes, and will lose
   points for time taken beyond the 60 minutes, as follows:

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 4
tasks.statement:
If, at the moment the team's solutions are handed in, n full minutes are left before the
   allotted time, then the sum total of the points obtained by the team for their solutions will
   be multiplied by a factor

                                           k = 1 + n/100,

    thus the team gets an extra 1% of their total result for every minute saved.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 5
tasks.statement:
If the team hand in their solutions n full minutes after the allotted 60 minutes have
   passed, the sum total of the points obtained by the team of the team will be multiplied by
   the factor

                                           k = 1 – n/100,

    thus the team will lose 1% of their result for every minute used beyond the allotted time.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 6
tasks.statement: The team with the most points after adjustment for time wins.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 7
tasks.statement:
Every student of the winning team will be given a prize and gold medal of the group
   competition.

                               Additional Instructions

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).
